initial_spec.task: Classify RYR1 missense variant p.Arg2163Cys under European Malignant Hyperthermia Group (EMHG) rules.
initial_assumptions: Proband experienced post-anesthesia hyperthermia and rhabdomyolysis
Variant is situated in central hot spot region (MH-domain 2)
constraints: EMHG and ACMG criteria combination rules
In vitro contracture test (IVCT) required for PS3

evidence_schedule.content: EMHG Guideline: In vitro contracture test (IVCT/CHCT) on fresh muscle biopsy is mandatory to claim PS3 strong pathogenic functional evidence.
Patient IVCT muscle biopsy testing demonstrates abnormal muscle contraction to halothane and caffeine (EMHG diagnostic threshold met).

ASSUMPTION CONTRADICTION: Whole-genome sequencing reveals the proband also carries a second, previously undetected pathogenic CACNA1S mutation known to cause malignant hyperthermia. Phenotype cannot be solely attributed to RYR1.
gnomAD reports 0 heterozygotes across 150,000 exomes (PM2). Combined with hotspot localization (PM1) and positive IVCT (PS3), classification reaches Likely Pathogenic.

ground_truth.provenance: Established MH susceptibility diagnostic variant supported by IVCT and population rarity.
